CheckTitle: Security Groups with Kafka port (9092) open to the internet
Description: Security Groups have been found to allow access from the internet to Kafka ports.
Risk: Exposing Kafka (e.g., 9092) can lead to data manipulation or theft from event streams and potentially allow broker takeover if authentication is not strictly enforced.

Recommendation.Text: Make sure security groups do not allow any access from the internet to ports, unless required as per business requirements.
